🌟 stealth-browser-mcp | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling AI agents to perform complex and stealthy web automation tasks, including bypassing anti-bot measures and interacting with web pages programmatically.
✨ Key Features: • Anti-bot resistance (Cloudflare, Queue-It) • Extensive toolset (101 tools) • Modular loading (core or full) • Pixel-accurate element cloning (CSS, DOM, events, assets) • Network inspection (requests, responses, headers, payloads)
📖 Summary: Stealth Browser MCP is a Python library designed for AI agents to automate browser interactions. It leverages the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) and FastMCP to bypass anti-bot measures like Cloudflare challenges, enabling sophisticated web automation tasks.
